offering_description.value: Sells a location-based social networking app for gay, bisexual, trans and queer people. It earns money from paid premium memberships and advertising, and is delivered as a mobile and web app.

primary_products.value: social networking app; premium membership tiers; in-app advertising placements

customer_segment.value: B2C: gay, bisexual, trans and queer men and other users of the app; B2B: advertisers and brands that buy in-app advertising

end_markets.value: consumer social networking; online dating; digital advertising

revenue_model.value: subscription: paid premium memberships that unlock extra app features; advertising: in-app ads sold to brands and agencies

value_chain_position.value: software / platform: operates the app and sells access to users and ad space to advertisers

geography_served.value: global: users in most countries worldwide, with large user bases in North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific

specialization.value: niche specialist: one social networking and dating app line aimed at LGBTQ users

distribution_channels.value: online: app stores and the company's own website; direct sales: direct sales of in-app advertising to brands and agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: data privacy and age rules, such as GDPR and consumer protection laws, plus advertising rules
